4 امرس الحَبْلَ , (inf. n. إِمْرَاسٌ, TA,) He restored the rope to the place [or groove of the sheave] in which it ran. (S, M, K.) ―
-b2- Also, He removed the rope from the place in which it ran; (TA;) he made the rope to stick fast between the sheave of the pulley and the قَعْو [or cheek]. (S, K, TA.) Thus it bears two contr. significations, on the authority of Yaakoob. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
